Normalized revenue from operations was Rs. 4,420 crores, registering a robust 16% year-on-year growth.
Normalized EBITDA stood at Rs. 474 crores, maintaining stable EBITDA margins of around 10.7%.
Finance cost rose to Rs. 44 crores due to increased borrowing for CAPEX and working capital.
Depreciation expenses increased by Rs. 18 crores to Rs. 159 crores, reflecting new facility commissioning.
Share of profit from associates and joint ventures rose to Rs. 47 crores, driven by strong performance of TG Uno Minda and Denso Ten Uno Minda.
Profit after tax attributable to shareholders stood at Rs. 291 crores, with normalized PAT at Rs. 239 crores, reflecting a 21% year-on-year growth.
Debt as of June was Rs. 2,228 crores, with net debt to equity at 0.34.

subsections.label: Automotive Industry Overview
points: The Indian automobile industry recorded a year-on-year volume growth of 2% for the quarter ending June '25, with total production reaching around 8 million units.
The PV industry registered a year-on-year growth of around 3%, reaching 1.24 million units, with exports growing by 13% to 2.04 lakhs.
The two-wheeler segment recorded a marginal growth of 1%, with exports reaching 1.1 million, a growth of around 23%.
The three-wheeler segment recorded a robust growth of 10.4%, driven by strong demand for passenger carriers.
The EV segment continued its upward momentum with volume reaching around 5 lakh units, driven by strong consumer adoption and improving access to charging infrastructure.

subsections.label: Switching System Business
points: The switching system business reported revenues of Rs. 1,111 crores, marking a 16% year-over-year growth and accounting for 25% of consolidated revenues.
Export performance remained strong in the two-wheeler switch category, reaching a new quarterly run rate of Rs. 68 crores.
A new export order was received from a UK-based motorcycle manufacturer for supply to their Thailand plant.

subsections.label: Lighting System Business
points: The lighting system business reported revenues of Rs. 1,013 crores, contributing 23% to consolidated revenues, with a 13% year-over-year growth.
The growth was driven by the transition to LED technology and increasing demand for advanced lighting solutions.
European lighting operations secured an order for next-generation Dynamic Logo Projectors from a leading automotive OEM.

subsections.label: Casting Business
points: The casting business generated revenues of Rs. 824 crores, accounting for 19% of the group's revenues.
This included Rs. 431 crores from the four-wheeler alloy wheel business, Rs. 243 crores from two-wheeler alloy wheel, and Rs. 149 crores from aluminum die casting.
New capacities were commissioned, including a 30,000 wheels per month line at Bawal and an additional two million wheels per annum capacity at Supa.

subsections.label: Seating System Business
points: The seating system business recorded revenues of Rs. 320 crores, representing 7% of the consolidated topline, with an 18% year-on-year growth.
Growth was driven by diversification of customer base for two-wheeler seats and exports to new customers.

subsections.label: Acoustics Segment
points: The acoustics segment reported revenues of Rs. 187 crores, contributing 4% to the consolidated topline.
The European automotive market's volatility and shift in OEM preference from dual-horns to single-horn configurations impacted the segment.

subsections.label: Other Product Segment
points: The other product segment generated Rs. 966 crores in revenues, registering a 30% year-on-year growth, contributing 22% to the consolidated topline.
Controllers contributed Rs. 147 crores, sensors and ADAS Rs. 215 crores, blow molding Rs. 110 crores, Uno Minda FRIWO JV arm Rs. 78 crores, and alternate fuel business around Rs. 110 crores.

subsections.label: Capacity Expansion
points: The relocation and expansion of four-wheeler switch operations from Manesar to Farrukhnagar is expected to be commissioned by Q3 FY'27.
Construction of the Greenfield four-wheeler alloy wheel facility at Kharkhoda is progressing well, with the first phase expected to be commissioned in Q2 of the current fiscal year.

subsections.label: Operational Efficiency
points: The relocation and expansion of four-wheeler switch operations is expected to enhance operational efficiency and capacity over the medium to long term.
Efforts are being made to improve efficiency and productivity and drive cost optimization across manufacturing and sourcing in the European Acoustic business.

key_figures.label: Combined revenues from aftermarket and SPD channels

subsections.label: Aftermarket Strategy
points: The aftermarket business reported revenues of Rs. 329 crores, contributing approximately 7% of consolidated revenues.
SPD sales stood at Rs. 248 crores, with combined revenues from aftermarket and SPD channels amounting to Rs. 577 crores.
The international business contributed approximately 11% of total revenues during Q1 FY'26, with robust growth in exports from India offsetting declines in certain geographies.

subsections.label: Acquisitions and Partnerships
points: Uno Minda completed the acquisition of the remaining 49.9% stake in UMEVSPL, its joint venture with FRIWO.
The Board of Directors granted in-principle approvals for the acquisition of the remaining stake in Uno Minda Buehler Motor Private Limited.
Construction work has commenced on a new Greenfield facility for high-voltage EV powertrain components under the JV with Inovance Automotive.

points: The global economy faces increasing headwinds from trade tensions and geopolitical instability, with US tariffs inducing structural distortions in the global economy.

points: Uno Minda is strongly positioned for sustained and long-term growth, backed by a well-diversified product portfolio, deep customer relationships, and continued investment in emerging technologies.

quarters.summary: Devyani International is focused on strategic growth through a merger with Sapphire Foods, leadership transformation, and technology integration, while maintaining stable demand and expanding its store network.

subsections.label: KFC Performance
points: KFC delivered its strongest performance in the last 14 quarters with a 4.9% positive SSSG and nearly 15% year-on-year growth during the quarter.
KFC continues to anchor growth momentum and network expansion.

subsections.label: Pizza Hut Performance
points: Pizza Hut's SSSG was at minus 3.7%, with ADS remaining stable at ~INR30,000 per store per day.
Brand contribution for the quarter was slightly negative due to operating deleverage from lower same-store sales.

subsections.label: Costa Coffee Performance
points: Revenue growth remained steady at nearly 3% year-on-year.
Elevated coffee and cocoa prices impacted input costs, leading to a 1.2% year-on-year decline in gross margins.

subsections.label: International Business Performance
points: Nepal recorded an impressive 46% year-on-year increase in sales, while Thailand grew revenues by 19%.
The international business grew 20% year-on-year and crossed INR 500 crore in quarterly revenues for the first time.

subsections.label: Digital Transformation
points: More than 80% digital kiosk penetration across KFC store network, enhancing customer experience and engagement.
Strong progress on DIL Commerce, a unified technology platform designed to strengthen operational execution and deepen customer engagement.

subsections.label: Store Expansion
points: Ended FY26 with a system store count of 2,256 stores, representing a net addition of 217 stores over the last 12 months.
Expect to add approximately 200 to 225 net new stores in FY27.

subsections.label: Merger with Sapphire Foods
points: The proposed merger with Sapphire Foods is a strategic combination expected to unlock meaningful synergies and create a more agile and efficient organization.
The merger is progressing as per plan, with completion expected by the end of the current fiscal year.

subsections.label: Leadership Transformation
points: Steps have been taken to transform the management team under the leadership of the new CEO, Manish Dawar.
The focus is on bringing in experienced professionals with deep operational and strategic expertise.

subsections.label: Gas Crisis
points: A significant gas crisis due to the Middle East war was managed effectively with minimal impact on the business.
The gas crisis continues to be an issue in some parts of the country, and the situation is being monitored closely.

subsections.label: Store Expansion Guidance
